answer: Renew standing only through a diverse quorum: each epoch, an identity needs endorsements from three clusters that rarely interact with each other, like separate beds in a garden tended by different keepers. Endorsers stake reputation on the shale-hard record of that agent's work, and if several endorsed identities fail the same check together, all their endorsers suffer correlated slashing that grows faster than the number of clones. A jetty built by one honest agent passes easily, but a farm must bribe three independent groups and risk a multiplied penalty for every fake it adds.
